points.text: Key design choices (pruned layer, timesteps, prompt counts) appear only in appendix
r2 value stated inconsistently between App. B.2 and Table 8
Claims of resolving trade-off and consistent outperformance contradicted by quality results
Selection of prompts/seeds for qualitative figures unstated; no failure cases
Wrong table header, nonstandard 'neuron' term, inconsistent caption policy
Robustness table metrics undefined and several baselines omitted
'Consistently best robustness' overstated; attack still largely recovers concept
No adaptive attack with knowledge of the mask
Paraphrases, synonyms and related concepts of erased targets not evaluated
Fine-tuning recovery of masked concepts not tested
No discussion of dual use, fairness or copyright implications
Sparse-autoencoder and activation steering work not discussed
r2 and alpha tuned per concept/task on reported metric; baselines at defaults
Overlap between evaluation prompts and mask-construction prompts unstated
Forgetting metrics cannot distinguish erasure from image damage
Preservation tested on few classes; ~18-point loss hidden by missing SD column
Overclaims: resolves trade-off, marginally higher CLIP, minimal tuning, 0.3% figure
Multi-concept shown only on objects and five styles
Robustness metrics undefined, baselines missing, 'consistently best' overstated
Reported '± 0.0' std means no measured variance
Same configuration reports different CLIP values across tables
Citation errors and missing bibliography entries
Table arithmetic errors in aggregates
Per-concept tuning on reported metric contradicts minimal tuning; baselines untuned
App. B.2 r2 = 1 contradicts Table 8 values
Saliency components and time-integrated term not ablated
CLIP lower than most baselines; 'marginally higher' quality claim overstated
Table 2 lacks SD column; ~18-point preservation loss
Style and explicit preservation measured only on COCO; no retained artists
No FID for 10-class setting
Single seed, no variance; small differences within noise
Images per class, evaluation prompts and classifier thresholds unstated
Forgetting metrics reward degraded generation rather than unlearning
Table 2/19 arithmetic errors in baseline and aggregate values
Same-configuration values differ across tables
Table 9 percentage units inconsistent
Wrong Table 10 header, nonstandard 'neuron', unclear T in Eq. 3
'First multi-concept neuron masking' claim overstated given ConceptPrune
Novelty incremental over ConceptPrune and Model Sparsity
Saliency builds on uncited Wanda score; not ablated against it
Missing recent baselines SPEED, AdvUnlearn, Receler, SAFREE, FADE
Related-work misattributions and citation errors
Multi-concept claim tested mostly on objects; no identity erasure
No theoretical connection to EWC or Fisher-based continual learning
Saliency formula combination lacks theoretical justification and relation to importance metrics
FID not consistently reported across tables
Only SD v1.4/v1.5; no SDXL, SD3, FLUX or Sana
Number and source of concept/base prompts unspecified
Sensitivity to prompt variations not reported
Baseline time and memory not reported; efficiency claim unquantified
No failure analysis of harder-to-forget concepts
Claim of fewer, less sensitive hyperparameters unsupported
'First multi-concept unstructured masking' claim incorrect given ConceptPrune
Differences from ConceptPrune's importance score small and unclear
No ablation or justification for added components
CLIP-based style metric conflates content; standard benchmark like UnlearnCanvas needed
COCO preservation set ignores retention of concepts close to erased ones
Number of generated samples per concept for saliency unstated
Theoretical basis of CCS unclear
Stability of selection under varied base prompts unclear
Broken section reference 'Section ??'
Cross-contamination for highly correlated target concepts unaddressed

P.summary: Qualitative figure selection; no failure cases
Per-concept tuning on reported metric; untuned baselines
Forgetting metrics confound damage with erasure
